This program was written by Steve Simon on 2024-10-15 and is placed in the public domain.

```{r 09-00-setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(yaml)
```

```{r}
#| label: t-curve

x <- seq(-6, 6, length=100)
y <- dt(x, 4)

data.frame(x, y) |>
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) + 
  geom_line(
    color="black",
    size=1) +
  expand_limits(y=0.4) +
  expand_limits(x=c(-7, 7)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(from=-6, to=6, by=2)) +
  labs(
    caption="Simon, 2024-10-06",
    x=" ",
    y=" ") -> t_curve
```

## plot01

```{r}
#| label: plot01

a <- qt(0.95, 4)
eq0 <- expression(paste("Area = 1 - ", alpha))
eq1 <- expression(paste("t(", alpha, ", df)"))
eq2 <- expression(paste("t(1-", alpha, ", df)"))
eq3 <- expression(paste("Area = ", alpha))
t_curve +
  geom_segment(x= a, y=0, xend= a, yend=0.38) +
  geom_label(x=0, y=0, label=eq0) +
  geom_label(x= a, y=0.4, label=eq2) +
  geom_label(x= a+1.4, y=0, label=eq3) -> plot01

plot01
ggsave("../images/plot01.png")
```

## plot02

```{r}
#| label: plot02

a <- qt(0.05, 4)
t_curve +
  geom_segment(x=a, y=0, xend=a, yend=0.38) +
  geom_label(x=0, y=0, label=eq0) +
  geom_label(x=a, y=0.4, label=eq1) +
  geom_label(x=a-0.9, y=0, label=eq3) -> plot02

plot02
ggsave("../images/plot02.png")
```
